name: Example table: bike route factors
description: How much each factor counts for or against three bike routes, from -1 to 1. One of nine example tables that illustrate ways to chart a comparison of scenarios, each row's scenario in its case column. The Nine ways to chart scenario comparisons test dataflow draws it as a matrix of circles sized by weight. Curio's seeded script scripts/build_example_scenario_charts.py writes it.
